scope: Read-only post-campaign diagnostic; cumulative statistics include fixture preparation and all trials, not measurement-specific.

data.indexdef: CREATE INDEX idx_likes_post ON public.likes USING btree (post)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX likes_pkey ON public.likes USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX likes_user_post_key ON public.likes USING btree ("user", post)
CREATE INDEX idx_posts_feed ON public.posts USING btree (created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_posts_own ON public.posts USING btree (author, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX posts_pkey ON public.posts USING btree (id)
